page.notes: Greek line after "meo iudicio" is partly unclear: the first word and the rest of the Greek phrase are read as ὑποσχοι ἂν ης δικαίως with uncertainty. The Hebrew after it is uncertain as well and is marked [?]. "Hæreseos" may show an æ ligature that is hard to see; it is given as printed. The top of the page has no running head.
